title: 立场论文：行为系统需要行为测试
summary: 本文主张AI智能体应像其他行为系统一样，通过系统观察、扰动和解释其行为来评估，而非仅关注性能结果。借鉴行为科学，提出研究议程：从动作序列恢复决策策略、构建区分行为差异的环境、探测多智能体系统的涌现动态，以发展AI行为科学。
summary_en: This position paper argues AI agents should be evaluated as behavioral systems via systematic observation, perturbation, and interpretation of actions, not just outcomes. Drawing on behavioral science, it proposes a research agenda for rigorous behavioral tests, including recovering decision strategies, isolating behavioral differences, and probing multi-agent dynamics.
